disambiguation: Not a full publishing platform; it focuses solely on converting and formatting Markdown for WeChat pasting.
extras: The plugin processes all data locally and does not upload notes or collect data.
intentEvidence: 一键复制，直接粘贴：将当前 Markdown 笔记复制为公众号富文本，保留预览中的排版。
motivation: To provide a simple, one-click solution for converting Markdown notes into WeChat-ready rich text with professional layouts.
problem: Manually formatting Markdown notes to fit the specific rich text requirements of WeChat official accounts is time-consuming and complex.

relations.evidence: Image Auto Upload Plugin 和 PicGo 负责图片上传，本插件只负责排版和复制。
